measurements: Full authenticated Hart archive, same 215 training/50 Test3 profiles. Archive pairing is established; contemporaneous independent per-file flow acquisition and electronics latency are unknown. sources: All 265 unsteady records, nominal 24 mm tube. Use whole measured chronological velocity and Re including signed values. Two processed input gauges as before, all three target stations. Entire past/future upstream archive/flow is allowed. Do not present this use of future input or target-history-based source preprocessing as a deployed online forecast.
pde: Effective modes solve C_t + (u(t)/slowness) C_x=D(t) C_xx in physical time; D=4e-10 m2/s assumed plus scale*0.024*abs(u)*(.41+1.17e9*max(3000,abs(Re))^-2.5). The continuation below 3000 and molecular floor are assumptions, not a physical calibration through reversals. Zero initial concentration, measured Dirichlet left boundary held over one native interval, distant zero-exterior boundary. Three-point Gaussian quadrature of advection/diffusion per native step and spatial linear interpolation are positivity preserving. First station predicts two signals at middle; their positive relative magnitude splits measured middle concentration, with symmetric 1e-7 upstream-peak floor. Two modes generated from that split predict the distal stations. No identification of actual radial flows or sensors. Required independently optimized one-mode spans slow & fast range .80,.92,1,1.08,1.35 and all dispersion values .5,1,2; the matched constant 1/2 two-speed mixture is independently optimized over the same pair grid. All calibration paths retained. Fit cells equally weighted, 215 all native time profiles.
